	prev_flavor = self.getSibling("previousFlavorDropdown").props.value
	next_flavor = self.getSibling("nextFlavorDropdown").props.value

	    WHERE m.SYSPROCompanyID         = 'H'

	    AND   m.AttributeName           = 'Blend_XTR'
	    AND   m.PreviousOpAttributeCode = ?
	    AND   m.NextOpAttributeCode     = ?
